A b o u t

Moe Pike Soe
Yangon · 2012

Moe Pike Soe aka The Beast is a self-taught graphic designer who likes to create colorful, bubbly and futuristic styles. Based in Yangon, Myanmar (Burma).

Create. Design. Inspire.

This site is a Tier B hybrid visual restore of the ~2012 Behance ProSite “geometric” portfolio formerly at TheBeastStudio.com. Navigation, titles, and descriptions are taken from Wayback Machine captures (May 2012 primary). Artwork is self-hosted from Wayback CDN snapshots, Behance-era features (PSDFan), and moepike.wordpress.com — never hotlinked to the dead behance.vo.llnwd.net CDN.

My Love

My sister taught me one thing about being in love: that you shall never get bored of your love. As a creative, I get my brain working and make a game with her. The game is about making everything we do count.

I love you, Ariel Thuta.

Facebook Cover Photo tutorial notes

Mar 19th · 2012
